components.detail: Intermittent errors on the publish API. Most publishes land, a failed one succeeds on retry. Published sites serve normally.

components.name: Canvas multiplayer
components.blurb: Live cursors and shared editing on the infinite canvas.

updates.text: Cause found: bursts of rapid publishes make the worker reload the space manifest often enough to trip its CPU limit, so a request caught mid-reload gets a 503. Retries go through and served sites are unaffected. The automatic platform re-bake behind publishes is also paused by a CI billing issue, which we are chasing separately.
